I have written Elm in 5 public repositories, from 2017 to 2018.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2), [Web](@/projects/web.md) (2) and [Security and OSINT](@/projects/security.md) (1).

Most recently: [the-scratch](@/work/the-scratch.md): Single Page Application written in Elm with Elixir/Phoenix Backend; [zaas](@/work/zaas.md): ZaaS - Zeman As A Service; [mapoffacts](@/work/mapoffacts.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Elm: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Elm to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
